description:
Position: Java Developer (GWT) 
 Location: Taylorsville, UT, United States 
 Duration: 6 Month Contract 
 
 We are looking for candidates to augment our existing staff to help us convert custom built Java/GWT/Hibernate applications from and Informix database environment to and Oracle database environment. 
 To be successful, candidates must have a minimum of 5 yrs. experience in Java, Google Web Toolkit (GWT), and Hibernate. These candidates will have access to systems with strict federal requirements. 
 Knowledge Skills and Abilities: 
 Expert with SOAP Web Services.
 Experience with Oracle database and Informix database development is requested 
 Design and analyze computer systems (i.e., hardware) 
 Upgrade computer hardware
 Use computer rational database software
 Evaluate information against a set of standards
 Speak clearly, concisely and effectively; listen to, and understand, information and ideas as presented verbally
 Principles, theories and practices of computer science 
 Deal with people in a manner which shows sensitivity, tact, and professionalism
 Test software using appropriate methodology and techniques
 Communicate information and ideas clearly, and concisely, in writing; read and understand information presented in writing
 Applicable maintenance methods and techniques
 Use State or agency-specific software application program(s)
 Make a decision of solve a problem by using logic to identify key facts, explore alternatives and propose quality solutions
 
 Client is only looking for US Citizens  

 Syed Mohammad Asif 
 408-775-7468
